card.name: Chemical exposure and hazard safety wording
card.fires_on: Words just before a hazard or danger term in emergency and exposure text, such as 'chemical' in 'exposure to chemical nerve agents' or 'contaminated' before 'area'. It also fires on small words in first-aid steps for victims.
